title: Query trace under coordinate permutations
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer, let $\Omega$ be a set of coordinate values, and let $\alpha$ be a set of leaf labels. Let $T$ be a finite decision tree with all $n$ coordinates available, let $\sigma$ be a permutation of those coordinates, and let $x$ assign a value in $\Omega$ to each coordinate. The query trace of the tree obtained by permuting the coordinates of $T$ on input $x$ is the list obtained by applying $\sigma$ to each coordinate in the query trace of $T$ on the input $i\mapsto x(\sigma(i))$.
hypotheses_covered: $\sigma$ is a permutation of the $n$ coordinates
